# Security reporting

Report credential disclosure, unintended gold/item transfers, unsafe update execution, or other exploitable behavior privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/BuildWithRaymond/DAMiner/security/advisories/new).

Include affected version, component, reproducible steps using fictional data, and likely impact. Never attach passwords, databases, live account names, tokens, or unsanitized captures. If private reporting is unavailable, request a private contact method from [BuildWithRaymond](https://github.com/BuildWithRaymond) without publishing exploit details.

Fixes target the latest stable release. Ordinary defects belong in Issues. DPAPI protects password files for the Windows user; it does not protect them from software already running as that user. Download hashes detect corruption, but are not independent publisher signatures.
